description: This file provides a data service module for a mechanic portal, handling requests, user sessions, and integration with Supabase or local storage for mock mode. It includes functions for creating, updating, and retrieving requests, managing user sessions, and normalizing vehicle and contact data.

methods.name: createRequest
methods.description: Creates a new service request, either via Supabase or local storage in mock mode.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user via Supabase or local credentials, establishing a session.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Ends the user session, either via Supabase or local storage.

methods.name: getCurrentUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current authenticated user info from Supabase or local storage.

methods.name: listUnassignedRequests
methods.description: Lists requests that are unassigned, from Supabase or local storage.

methods.name: listMyAssignments
methods.description: Lists requests assigned to a mechanic, via Supabase join or local storage.

methods.name: getRequestById
methods.description: Fetches a specific request by ID from Supabase or local storage.

methods.name: acceptRequest
methods.description: Assigns a request to a mechanic, updating status and notes, via Supabase or local storage.

methods.name: updateRequestStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a request, adding a note, via Supabase or local storage.

methods.name: updateProfile
methods.description: Updates user profile information in Supabase or local storage.

methods.name: isSupabaseConfigured
methods.description: Checks if Supabase environment variables are set, indicating configuration.
